sourceRefs.locator: X.16, pp. 123–126: complaints, Leubovera’s answers, Didimia confirming her gift to the abbess and the judges’ reasons for retaining her.
Section on the nuns of Poitiers, pp. 136–142; narrative setting of the 589 appeal, inserted letters in IX.39–42 and the episcopal tribunal of 590 in X.16.

summary.de: Die Äbtissin musste sich den Beschwerden der Nonnen stellen. Der Bericht der Bischöfe gibt ihre Antworten wieder.
summary.en: The abbess faced the nuns’ complaints. The bishops’ report records her answers.
